terra.problem: The passage does not say Jeremiah served for eleven full years under Zedekiah, or that his whole career came before Zedekiah's reign.
Saying the LORD said this before Jeremiah was born confuses when Jeremiah was appointed with when the LORD spoke to him.
The passage does not say Jeremiah would speak to each of the three named kings.
The explanation is flat and generic, ending by simply restating the answer.
The text does not say Jeremiah spoke quickly. 'I think' marks the proposed reason as a guess, but treats the speed as a fact.
Saying Jeremiah did better than the baker gave him credit for puts blame on the baker for the missed answer.
The explanation identifies the word the LORD watches over specifically as the word given to Jeremiah to speak. The verse does not make that identification.
The verse does not say the LORD's word here is the same specific word Jeremiah was given to speak.
Saying he won't joke comments on how Papa tells the passage.
The front-door chair comparison makes a joke of the approaching attack, a serious threat of violence.
The chapter mentions burning incense but does not mention altars.
Saying he'll keep his hands to himself on the serious line comments on how he tells the passage.
The LORD makes Jeremiah like bronze walls; the explanation turns that comparison into a claim that He built walls for him.
